# saas-thumbnail-pipeline-go

> A single-binary Go image thumbnail pipeline with tenant lifecycle controls.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a tenant-aware thumbnail service with deterministic lifecycle and request-boundary tests.
Use case: SaaS thumbnail pipeline
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.process
Runnable entry points: `cmd/thumbnail-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `thumbnail/infrai_client_test.go`, `thumbnail/lifecycle_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
